description:
Bell Cottage, Cappagh, Sixmilebridge, Co. Clare, V95 C576

Anthony McGann of Keller Williams is proud to present this charming two-bedroom semi-detached cottage with a west-facing rear garden, generous courtyard and substantial Steeltech shed.

Set in the countryside just outside Sixmilebridge, Bell Cottage brings together the character of a traditional cottage and the comfort of a beautifully presented, turnkey home. Built circa 1933 and extending to approximately 76 sq m (818 sq ft), it offers bright, welcoming rooms and plenty of useful space outdoors.

The entrance hall leads into a dual-aspect kitchen and dining room, where cream country-style shaker units, solid wood worktops and a tiled splashback create a warm, inviting feel. There is ample storage and room for a dining table, along with an electric oven and hob, extractor fan and integrated dishwasher.

The generous living room is filled with natural light from windows on two sides and a skylight. Its stone and red-brick fireplace houses a solid-fuel stove connected to a back boiler, making this an especially cosy place to relax. Fitted TV cabinetry provides additional storage.

A glazed rear porch leads to the bright utility room, which has shaker-style storage, open shelving and space for a washing machine and tumble dryer. The fully tiled bathroom has a skylight, electric shower, vanity unit, heated towel rail and access to a shelved hot press.

Both bedrooms are well presented. The primary bedroom features red deal flooring, sliding wardrobes, fitted drawers and open shelving. The second bedroom has laminate flooring and a large window.

Outside, the tarmacadam driveway provides ample parking and leads to a spacious courtyard bordered by mature trees and block-built walls. The west-facing rear garden is a lovely spot to enjoy the afternoon and evening sun. There are also two purpose-built dog kennels and a substantial Steeltech shed with an electric roller door, ideal for storage or hobbies. The property has a paved front garden and is set up for electric gates.

Bell Cottage has oil-fired central heating with an external condensing boiler, double-glazed windows and PVC front and side doors.

Location

Sixmilebridge offers shops, cafés, pubs, a library, credit union and primary school, together with an active community and local sports clubs. Its railway station provides connections to Limerick, Ennis and Galway, while Shannon and Shannon Airport are accessible by car. Nearby Bunratty has restaurants, pubs and shops, as well as Bunratty Castle and Folk Park. The 12 O’Clock Hills and Cratloe Woods offer plenty of choice for walks and days outdoors.

Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment with the sole selling agent.
